families.name: Button
families.contract: One primary action per decision; keyboard focus is distinct from selection.

families.name: Text field
families.contract: Keep a persistent label. Explain errors next to the field.

families.name: Select
families.contract: Bounded options; arrow navigation, Enter selection, Escape dismissal.

families.name: Switch
families.contract: Immediate setting change; 40×20 track inside a 44×32 target.

families.name: Checkbox
families.contract: Membership; the full label row is clickable. Clear means None.

families.name: Radio choice
families.contract: One active choice. Arrows wrap; Home and End reach the edges.

families.name: Tool chip
families.contract: Use aria-pressed. This changes capability without running a job.

families.name: Confidence badge
families.contract: High, Medium and Low qualify a suggestion; text carries the meaning.

families.name: Folder card
families.contract: Choosing a source or destination changes scope, not files.

families.name: AI rule dialog
families.contract: Clarify, review, then apply settings. File moves still require preview confirmation.

families.name: Preview row
families.contract: Show original identity, destination and attribution; Figma is an anatomy specimen.

limits: Disabled tool and selection states are design specifications
